description.text: The second Platinum set, released on 16 May 2009 with 120 cards: 111 numbered, three secret remakes of the Pikachu, Flying Pikachu and Surfing Pikachu of the early years, and a subset numbered RT1 to RT6 of Rotom's five forms and Charon's Choice. It turns to Sinnoh's Gym Leaders and Elite Four with two new kinds of Pokémon SP, Gym Leader's Pokémon (GL) and Elite Four's Pokémon (E4), more than 30 SP in all, and it has nine Pokémon LV.X, among them Luxray GL, Gallade E4 and Snorlax. Its theme decks are Cutting Edge and Drill Point.
